doc: fx_colour.py families: files = PNG name prefixes in the weapon FX folder; tokens = palette token -> the sheet's colour (r2_w4_fx_colour.jpg). Tokens not listed keep their colour (the ink outline always stays ink).

families.note: n5-look iteration 14 (r2_w4 top left: the muzzle flashes grade white-hot at the bore -> hot yellow -> orange tips at the outline; ours printed a pale cream star with a darker orange heart, the gradient inverted, as blast_0 was): applied after muzzle, which it overrides for the gun flashes (spark_ keeps muzzle): the heart (vermilion) goes white-hot, the body hot yellow, and rim paints an orange band rim.px part px inside the ink outline (tools/art/fx_rim.py; the white-hot core is left alone). Drop this family = the muzzle family's flash; drop rim = the white core in a yellow body.
a thin hot-yellow streak, light orange tail (the sheet's SMG rounds)

n5-look iteration 16 (r2_w4 top right: the flame is a yellow core under a ragged orange rim; ours printed one amber tone): applied after explosion, which it overrides for the flame cells; the body hot yellow and rim paints an orange band rim.px part px inside the ink (tools/art/fx_rim.py; the white-hot core is left alone). Drop this family = the explosion family's amber flame.

the first blast frame: its burst was paper with a vermilion core, so the explosion family printed a white star round an orange heart; r2_w4 wants the white-hot core inside the orange-yellow, so this frame swaps them (applied after explosion, which it overrides)

pale violet-white. n5-look iteration 14 (r2_w4: the arc is a white-hot core inside a violet edge; ours printed one lavender fill): paper #E4D6FF -> #FBF8FF and a violet rim #9A7CF0 4 part px inside the ink (fx_rim.py, core_min 256 = every fill pixel). Drop rim and paper back to #E4D6FF = before.
acid green (iteration 5: ink_2 and wash brightened; the rings printed a dull olive at 32 px/m)
r2_w4's beam: the ray family's acid green with a white-hot core (n5-look iteration 16; drop this family and add ray_beam_ back to ray = the pale green core)
pale crystal, cyan-white glint (teal is souls only)

n5-look iteration 8 (r2_w4): the smoke ring was painted orange whole (wash -> orange); the sheet has dark smoke with the fire inside it, so this frame takes dark smoke and an orange band along the ring's inner edge (inner.px part px; tools/art/fx_colour.py inner_band). Drop this family = before. Iteration 10: pockets (r2_w4: ragged fire pockets, not a ring): 9 round orange pockets with a hot yellow core moved toward the blast centre (core_in; centred, it read as a target), hash-placed on the ring's inner edge, clipped to the smoke (fx_colour.py pockets); when present they replace the inner band. Drop pockets = the iteration 8 band. Iteration 11: wobble 0.2 (a hashed 3- and 5-lobe radial wobble of each pocket edge, r2_w4's ragged fire tongues; 0 = the round iteration 10 pockets) with r_px 30-52 (was 25-45: the lumpy edge eats fire area). Also iteration 11: graded fire, hot #FFF2C0 at hot_k 0.5 of the core (core_k 0.5 -> 0.62): orange edge -> yellow -> white-hot toward the blast centre (r2_w4); drop hot = the single yellow core. Iteration 12: flash (r2_w4: the blast keeps a white-hot core and yellow radial spikes through the smoke; ours printed a hollow grey ring): tools/art/fx_flash.py paints n 22 ink-outlined yellow spikes from the centre to r_out x the half cell, a ragged 20-point yellow burst filling the ring's hollow (burst_k x its inner radius) and a white-hot star inside (hot_k x the burst). Drop flash = the iteration 11 frame. Iteration 12b: flash.mid #F08A24 at mid_k 1.2 x the burst (an orange tier between the yellow burst and the smoke, r2_w4's graded core; drop mid = the yellow star alone).
